payload.body: JUST IN - Starmer says organizers of the "Unite the Kingdom" rally in London, on Saturday, "are peddling hatred and division, plain and simple," and says he will ban people from coming to the UK who are seeking to stir up "hatred." MORE - Starmer adds that UK has, "already blocked visas for far-right agitators who want to come here to spew their extremist views. They don't speak for the decent, fair, respectful Britain I know." @disclosetv
